nodes.label: Duplicate-File-Per-Icon-Slot Workaround
nodes.rationale: Two different AppIcon slots both require a 120x120 raster: 40pt@3x and 60pt@2x (the home screen icon). The asset catalog's Contents.json requires a distinct filename for each slot entry, so the same 120px render is committed twice, as '120.png' and '120 1.png' (byte-identical, md5 102cb46e3959b3407e09e6cb1dd4fa43). The space-in-filename form is the Finder/Preview duplicate naming convention, indicating the copy was made by hand rather than by an export pipeline. Trade-off accepted: a few KB of redundancy and a fragile hand-made filename, in exchange for not needing an icon generation step. Risk: the two files can drift if the artwork is ever updated in only one place.
